name: Daily Airtable to Snowflake sync with change detection

workflow_json.name: Daily Airtable to Snowflake sync with change detection

parameters.query: MERGE INTO ANALYTICS.CUSTOMERS t USING (SELECT :id id, :hash hash) s ON t.ID=s.ID WHEN MATCHED AND t.HASH<>s.HASH THEN UPDATE SET HASH=s.HASH WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (ID,HASH) VALUES (s.ID,s.HASH);

parameters.functionCode:
const events = $json.ticket_metric_events || [];
return events.map(e=>({json:{id:e.id, ticket_id:e.ticket_id, type:e.type, time:e.time, created_at:e.created_at}}));

parameters.query: INSERT INTO zendesk_ticket_metrics (id,ticket_id,type,time,created_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING;
